purpose: Teach: サックス/ダイビング/モデム/ロジック/スロット/エッチ/楽園/着席

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはサックスをかつて吹いてらしたのよ
lines.en: Your dad used to play the saxophone, you know.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Speaking as though sharing a small piece of family history. Gentle cadence, like offering a gift to understand his father better.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとダイビング体験したいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go diving with Dad.
lines.style: Direct, bright request with genuine excitement. Quick tempo, no hesitation. The eagerness of a six-year-old who has thought of something he really wants.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、モデムから光回線になった話してたわ
lines.en: Your dad was explaining how we switched from modem to fiber internet, and it was quite something.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly amused. Speaking as though recalling a moment that impressed her. Steady pacing, warm undertone — noticing something good in him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの説明のロジック、すごいと思う
lines.en: I think the way Dad explains things is really smart.
lines.style: Sincere observation, pride evident but not performed. Quiet conviction. Eyes engaged. A child recognizing something real about someone he respects.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ゲームのスロットだけはやり過ぎちゃダメよ
lines.en: Just don't get carried away with game slots, alright?
lines.style: Firm but not cold. The voice of gentle boundary-setting. Slight emphasis on the warning itself. Practical, caring — a mother's regular check-in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、エッチな漫画は読まないよ
lines.en: I don't read that kind of manga, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet assurance, slightly embarrassed but earnest. Not defensive — just stating a fact about himself. Small, genuine voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、ぼくの楽園だよ
lines.en: Mei's shop is like my paradise.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. Speaks slowly, like he's thought about this before. Tenderness without performance — a quiet truth about feeling safe somewhere.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに着席って言われたよ
lines.en: Dad told me to sit down.
lines.style: Quiet report, slightly uncertain in tone. Sharing something that happened. Small, observant voice — noticing but not fully understanding the weight of it yet.
